**SQL (Structured Query Language) samjhiye!**

🎯 Definition: SQL ek programming language hai jo data ko manage karne ke liye use kiya jata hai, khass taur par database management ke liye.

**📚 Real Example:**
Aapke paas ek dukaan hai, aur aapke paas customer ki jaankari, product ki jaankari, aur sale ki jaankari hoti hai. Aapko yeh sab data manage karna hota hai, aur SQL aapke liye ek tarika hai is data ko manage karne ke liye.

**🔢 How it works:**
SQL ka kaam karna seekhne ke liye, aapko basic commands seekhne honge, jaise ki:
- SELECT: Yeh command aapko data ko select karne ki anumati deta hai.
- FROM: Yeh command aapko data ko source se select karne ki anumati deta hai.
- WHERE: Yeh command aapko data ko filter karne ki anumati deta hai.
- INSERT: Yeh command aapko data ko add karne ki anumati deta hai.
- UPDATE: Yeh command aapko data ko update karne ki anumati deta hai.
- DELETE: Yeh command aapko data ko delete karne ki anumati deta hai.

**🌍 Applications:**
SQL ka upyog kai jagah par hota hai, jaise ki:
- Database management: Yeh SQL ka sabse common upyog hai, jahaan aapko database ko manage karna hota hai.
- Web development: Yeh SQL ka upyog web developers use karte hain apne web application ko database se connect karne ke liye.
- Data analysis: Yeh SQL ka upyog data analysts use karte hain apne data ko analyze karne ke liye.
